concepts.def: Fights infection — part of immune system.
Tiny cells helping blood to clot.
Liquid part of blood carrying cells and nutrients.
Coronary heart disease — blocked coronary arteries.
Force of blood on artery walls (systolic/diastolic).

walkthroughs.body_html: Blood contains red blood cells (oxygen transport via haemoglobin), white blood cells (immunity), platelets (clotting) and plasma (liquid carrying nutrients, hormones and waste).

CHD occurs when fatty deposits narrow coronary arteries, reducing oxygen to heart muscle. Risk factors: smoking, high-fat diet, inactivity, stress. Aerobic exercise widens arteries, lowers blood pressure and resting HR — reducing risk.
Blood pressure is given as systolic over diastolic, in mmHg. Normal is around 120/80. Regular endurance exercise lowers blood pressure. High BP (hypertension) strains the heart and arteries.
